Subtract 39 weeks = 273 days.  
273 days + 1 day = 274 days before 1713-10-15.  
1713 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days before: Oct 15 → back 274 days:  
From Oct 15 back 15 days → Sep 30.  
From Sep 30 back 259 days (274 - 15 = 259).  
259 days before Sep 30: Jan has 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30.  
Sum from Jan 1 to Sep 30 = 273 days in year 1713.  
259 days before Sep 30 = 273 - 259 = 14 days into the year = Jan 14, 1713.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1713-01-14
